Definition: from G1909 and G4863; to collect upon the same place:--gather (together).
BiblicalUsage: Episynago means to gather together — to collect upon the same place. O Jerusalem, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not; and He shall send His angels, and they shall gather together His elect from the four winds.
TheologicalSignificance: The hen who would gather and was refused, and the angels who will gather and cannot be refused — the gathering shows the heart of Christ twice. I believe His longing to gather Jerusalem is the measure of His love for me, and His final gathering is the measure of His power.
